context:
Goal: a guard one repo earned protects every repo, without building shared tools no other repo uses.
Problem (goal): five guards exist in only one child repo; promoting now costs a lane each, waiting leaves other repos open to the same mistake.
Based on (read): plan rows: mailaudit 7 (milestone full-suite job), 17 (a decision's 'Holds while' line; 0 of 169 cs decisions carry it), 18 (screen overflow, a11y and 44 px target checks); banchi 30 (one browser fleet per machine); degen 17 (waiting-page export scan).
Based on (incident): banchi 2026-09-07, 18 failures from two browser fleets (row 30); mailaudit, 3 unexplained screen reds (row 18).
Departs from: claude-settings main, which has none of these five — option a adds them now.

options.gain: Every repo gets the five guards before it repeats the mistake.
options.how: Each row becomes a promotion lane in claude-settings, then the child removes its copy.
options.label: Promote now
options.lose: Five more lanes now, some for repos that may never need them.

options.gain: No shared tool is built before it is needed twice.
options.how: Each row stays in its repo until a second repo hits the same mistake.
options.label: Wait for a second repo
options.lose: The second repo pays for the mistake first.

ref: docs/plans/child-guard-promotion.md on PR #1119 (ea66d8e), owner question 3: mailaudit rows 7, 17, 18; banchi row 30; degen row 17
title: Promote guards that only one repo has built now, or wait until a second repo needs them?
why: Each row has an incident or a rule behind it, and the shared skills (screens, waiting page) already serve every repo.
